scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @lauf/shared build && concurrently "pnpm --filter frontend dev" "pnpm --filter backend start:dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @lauf/shared build && pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter backend lint && pnpm --filter frontend lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @lauf/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter backend typecheck && pnpm --filter frontend typecheck
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter backend exec prisma migrate dev
